summary.text: One of the fifty daughters of Danaus by Pieria — by lot the bride of Egyptus son of Egyptus when the sons of Aegyptus by Gorgo married the Pieria maidens at Argos; not to be confused with the twin brother Aegyptus himself.

story.text: Apollodorus lists Dioxippe third among the daughters of Danaus borne on Pieria. When the sons of Egyptus by Gorgo cast lots for the Pieria maidens, Egyptus — a son of that name, not the patriarch — drew Dioxippe. On the wedding night she received her father's dagger and, like her sisters, slew her bridegroom — Hyginus counts her among the brides who obeyed Danaus.
